····跟随但丁，堕入神曲的地狱狂潮吧！ ———————————— 对这款游戏目前总体评价 8/10 个人是从粉丝角度来看这部新作，作为《化妆镜》起步的as开发组的新作，本作还是延续工作室一贯超高水准的美术与配乐，也是大量玩家最初选择这款游戏的理由，幸存者玩法市场已经饱和了，大伙主要冲着美术音乐、演出和百合来的，这一作还有部分关键剧情有英配音，不同于前作，希望之后出日配。 复古90年代动画画风精致考究，哥特曲风氛围感十足，某种意义上将但丁《神曲》地狱以另一种形式完美烘托。诗人之间的对话甜甜的，相比之前as的作品，各个角色联系更深，算是有趣的地方！ ----玩法上，类幸存者我想大家已经吃腻了，不多述说。如果硬要说的话，抢先体验版对比demo加了帮助玩家过渡和来肝着玩的局外成长系统，但是卡牌平衡、深度和仍然需要有很多平衡的地方（如果你是特别注重玩法的幸存者肉鸽爱好者，那这一作你可能不太会满意，目前是不算太平衡的，比如到了第二层地狱你会发现小怪难度上升很多，但丁和绿毛的初武器没成长容易坐牢，月球爆炸神等等） 还有的问题是，游戏手柄操作会选不上卡牌，会卡等等。然后就是后面高等级特效太多太花眼，我想大家都有看不到自己鼠标而感慨的时候，建议后面优化弹幕多的时候的透明度，最好是能自己调整特效。 其中，游戏优化上也是，目前bug不少（比如贺拉斯开车大招会留在地图、宝箱卡地形）很多小伙伴反应···打完一关黑屏、花屏和闪退问题，看到想玩的游戏出现这种状况真的很烦躁。介于制作组首次尝试新的游戏类型，可以谅解，但是还是速速修复，要不然太糟心了，不过我个人认为这是能很快解决的问题，所以还是比较期待游戏未来发展的 最后，对比制作组以往定价偏高的前作，38元的首发定价显得十分亲民。（化妆镜76，小红鞋120），抢先体验这个价格真是明智的策略，要什么自行车！牛逼！（请注意正式版会涨价，所以如果比较喜欢和能接受瑕疵可以考虑买，）目前群内有卡牌和武器图鉴，需要可以加官群

[h1]意大利故事原型，日式复古画风，英文配音，韩文初始页面，你究竟是什么游戏？[/h1] 本作延续同制作组一贯以来的的高质量制作，复古画风音乐共同演绎出的高水准演出赏心悦目，还有结合女同性恋和女同性恨的大乱炖式女女关系性可以品鉴，从demo时期关注到现在终于上线了。 虽然ea版相比demo时期内容量没有增加太多，不过局内体验相比demo优化了很多，如增加了回血道具掉率，局内临时buff，永久buff，角色终结技能量的掉率。也更新了利好快速度过局内前期的局外成长功能。 总的来说作为一个类幸存者游戏，如果后续内容更新的体量像商店描述的这样多，那么目前ea版38的定价绝对物超所值。 [b]但为什么这是一个差评？[/b] [h2]因为我在游戏发售后就光速入手，兴致勃勃玩了一个小时，五把游戏里不闪退的次数居然高达1次，那我问你我结算不了我的局外成长代币要怎么获得😡😡😡[/h2] 抛开闪退不谈，我不太建议更在乎游戏性的玩家现在入手这款游戏，因为目前呈现的游戏内容无论是和幸存者本体相比还是和市面上的热门类幸存者游戏相比仍有一些牌组构筑深度和宽度上的差距。
你能想象吗？38块钱，有配音有动画，而且水准都不低....BGM好听，画风复古但精细... 精致的像素肉鸽，除了良心，我不想多说

作为神话厨＋肉鸽爱好者＋百合豚，简单测评一下。那我的评价是：[h1] 不推荐现在入手，未来可期，可以等正式版再入手 [/h1] 具体原因如下：1.目前没有可选难度的选项。本人Hades两部曲＋暗黑地牢＋杀戮尖塔都基本上全通了，这部难度对新手肉鸽玩家确实偏大，如果是冲着美少女女同来的完全不熟悉此类游戏的，那目前这个难度真的很劝退，而且不能选难度，虽然相较demo还是改良了许多，但对新手不太友好。 2.是卡牌构筑体系还未完善，不能做到像杀戮尖塔那种卡组搭配强大手感，还有就是武器上手手感也不行，贺拉斯的泥头车操作手感让我像吃了屎，总之就是让我上手很难受。 推荐理由如下： 1.我是百合豚，女同女同我们需要更多真百女同游戏，而且这个公司的美工真的做的特别好，很完美....动画和op配乐都无懈可击。 2.作为资深神话厨，能看见我最喜欢的诗人荷马和维吉尔互动真的很幸福，，，而且居然还是全员性转我好爽！看得出制作组再神曲和诗人们考究上下了功夫，很喜欢角色设定，神话厨必拿下。 不过我个人其实还是相当喜欢这款游戏的，画风真的很复古美型，而且呢[h1] 这可是女同版性转神曲啊！ [/h1]，角色设计也很萌萌哒，有谁能拒绝全性转妹子希腊罗马诗人们，诗人们你们一定要卖姬卖姬，我还是觉得未来可期的，官方态度也很好，改的很快，还是给个好评吧！

Usually this type of game isn't my thing, but since I played previous games from these devs, I wanted to give it a try, and, well, I'll like it so far. I know this is early access and the game isn't completed yet, but it does offer a lot. The whole opening was just awesome! The character designs and their voice actors are amazing as well, and I can't wait to meet them all! I haven't discovered a lot in my playtime, but I certainly died a few times. While a bullet hell game might not be my favorite genre, I do like the deck-building aspect.

刚打通第二层先来写个评测！ 依旧是熟悉的复古动漫画风，依旧是熟悉的百合（应该是）！《化妆镜~黄金之梦》和《little goody two shoes》制作组的新作《地狱公主》终于端上来啦！ 期待了很久的作品 本作在玩法上选择了前几年大火的类幸存者的玩法，客观的说这类玩法已经很难再作创新，再攀新高了，如果是冲着玩法来的话，更建议去玩那几个经典的老前辈。 剧情目前来看信息量比较少，我们作为主角但丁正不断的探索地狱，寻找伙伴，角色间互动很有趣。而我们的但丁开局为何失忆以及在天堂发生了什么是最大的谜题。 音乐美术超级对味！每段演出每首音乐都十分好听，开场曲《Not My Paradiso》由Mili制作！我期待的就是这个呀😋😋😋 结合38元的首发售价，可以说是性价比十足啦，只买视听体验都不亏的程度！对比前两作售价分别为76/120元。 而且ea阶段结束后会涨价，感兴趣的小伙伴最好在此阶段购买哦 （看到有的评测中反映游戏难度过高。听我的，先用但丁的羽毛笔随便混两局解锁维吉尔的祝福，再带上她的初始武器，局内再选择【月球爆炸】武器卡，你会体验到什么是轮椅！第二层的魅魔可以用贺拉斯的大招开大运应对，全程无敌横冲直撞助你轻松通过色欲层，只要开局选她的初始武器就好）

原本挺喜欢这游戏不想打差评的，但是恶性bug实在太多。 1.简中默认进游戏是韩语，得进游戏自己打开菜单摸半天设置把语言调回简中； 2.释放神术的动画巨卡无比，甚至出现过神术动画直接覆盖游戏画面而游戏还在背景运行的情况； 3.淫狱BOSS战,BOSS一阶段空血不转阶段，游戏菜单按了也没反应，只能强退。 游戏玩法方面不满意的地方：伤害基本全靠局内的卡牌，局外成长给的很少而且局外系统很空洞，感觉没啥重复刷的动力，十分担心此游戏未来的前景。 2026年7月18日更新： 看到游戏目前的评价是特别好评，我还是比较开心的，说明只要制作组稍微有点良心的话，应该短期内还不会跑路烂尾。但是，即便游戏最近两个补丁修复了不少bug，我依旧不推荐现阶段购买此游戏。原因很简单： 内容极少，总共就两张地图，局外成长系统太乏味且作用小，没有重复刷的动力。 玩DEMO版的时候，我还能因为新鲜劲，哪怕就一张图，也能刷个几小时，于是便在第一时间购入的EA版。结果很失望，bug比DEMON版多了无数个，内容却乏善可陈，完全没有”再刷一把“的欲望。别提什么roadmap，一张图片画的大饼，能不能圆，能圆多少一切都是未知数。倘若制作组你真是想对玩家负责，切实想要把roadmap的内容一一实现，不愧对玩家的期待，那么为什么你们第一时间放出的收费游戏版本，却是一个满地恶性bug的游戏？ 真心希望制作组能站在玩家的角度考虑问题。 也说一下这个游戏的优点吧： 美术风格、音乐都不错。除此之外，游戏里的武器性能没有照搬其他幸存者like游戏，再加上局内的卡牌系统，整个局内设计还是挺有新意的。 然而第一时间推出的EA版本实在让我大失所望（也许是我对制作组的期待太高了），感觉没法信任此游戏制作组，所以也无法给这个游戏好评并推荐给其他人。

本来是看见mili买的，先说结论，38元我认为是值的 评论区反应的闪退问题，个人打到图二时也没有遇到 玩法就是市面上常见的肉鸽游戏（不过局外养成难度有点大，资源需求真不小）。游戏的美术和动画我是很喜欢的，只是但丁立绘，不好意思，我把黑布料看成手臂了😀 剧情方面玩过开发商游戏的懂得都懂，唯一想吐槽的是但丁搞百合是不是太地狱了（疑似主角被困地狱真实原因） 游戏性想浅浅的批评一下，有点过于单薄了，现版本的肉鸽+卡牌堆砌玩法恐怕很难让玩家深陷其中。甚至到了可能要再加不少设计的程度（期待一手创意工坊） 能看出制作组是用心设计了，《神曲》的背景不单单是噱头，图二的狂风机制真的是读过原著才能get到的小巧思，也期待制作组接下来的更新

Let me quickly start out by saying the short and simple version: This game is worth 10 dollars. It's worth more than that actually, and this is an absolute steal. If you're even slightly interested in picking it up, I highly recommend. It's a little bit cluttered and could use some polish in a few areas, but it's insanely fun as is and I can't wait for more to be added. Now to dig into the nitty gritty a little bit more. When I first saw one of these "bullet heaven" games a few years ago, I thought they looked kinda silly and honestly unfun. I don't know, I've never been the biggest fan of this style of game for some reason that I can't explain. As a result, I like to think I'm a bit unbiased on my recommendation of this game. The only bias I have is that I liked Pocket Mirror and Little Goody Two Shoes, both games from Astral Shift, and that is solely the reason I decided to give this game a try. I love their art style, music, and overall presentation, so all of this hooked me in. Aside from this, I have no other reason to try this type of game. And despite this game being the first I've ever played in the genre, I love the Hell out of it. The story is intriguing, nothing crazy has happened so far, but there's a bit of a mystery involved that keeps you interested. The gameplay is really fun, and I love how wacky you can get with a lot of the cards (weapon mods) you can find. I had a run where I just kept adding projectile +1 and attack speed % to everything and I had abilities firing off left and right all over the place. I could just stand there and the entire screen was cleared of enemies. It was kinda goofy, but insanely fun and honestly a huge rush. Building off of that though is basically my one and only complaint: sometimes the clutter on screen is just a bit too much. Not only are a ton of your own weapons firing off every second or two, enemies are flinging dozens of shots from all over the place. Tiny enemies that are hardly even noticeable can sometimes sneak in from out of nowhere and damage you, enemy attacks can kinda blend in with your own attacks and hit you suddenly. It's a biiiit chaotic and hard to discern. It's definitely not IMPOSSIBLE to manage (I play League of Legends so I'm used to a buncha BS on screen) but it definitely could use some polish. I highly recommend adding an opacity setting, and maybe making it so all enemy projectiles are highlighted red. Maybe highlight the enemies in red too. To be honest, this is my only game I've played of this genre so I don't have a ton of suggestions, but that's what I came up with off the top of my head while playing. Now, to cap this review off, I'd like to highlight a lot of the strengths again. The art and music is BEAUTIFUL. The gameplay is FUN and has a lot of replayability. The story is interesting enough to keep you pushing forward. The characters are all very fun, and I like interacting with them whenever I can. Despite this being an Early Access game, there's a lot of content here to keep you entertained. I have about 5 hours so far, and I'm aaaalmost about to finish the 2nd Circle, so I probably have about 2ish more hours to go maybe. And all of this for 10 dollars???? Please do yourself a favor and just pick it up if you're here and thinking about it. It's a lot of fun and worth every penny! Looking forward to what comes next!
一个字难。容错率非常低，开局随不到想要的本局基本查无此人。外部构筑所需钱币惊人，给的提升聊胜于无，除了画面与音乐，够不到很多同类吸血鬼游戏的脚底。 妈的，越玩越气，傻逼般的攻击动作，屎一样的局外成长，脚填的怪数值，神仙一样的怪机制。唯一一款让人越玩越生气的游戏。

感觉第一关做出来是防退款的，因为第二关不论是难度还是机制都高得离谱，简直就像一坨构式，当然更因为我打通了第二关之后直接黑屏了，存档没存上，哈哈，成就都弹出来了，结果要重新打。 20260718：第二关的角色也解锁了，真的是不知道设计这么恶心的机制究竟是图什么，到解锁地点前是要跑365里路的，跑的过程中是要同时打小怪躲齿轮的，到了地方之后是要继续打一个塔+躲机制+打小怪的，打塔的过程中是一口血也不给的。（当然在这过程中又一次的、我打完甚至剧情都过完了，到小boss，被打死之后直接黑屏，依旧没保存上，又要重打。）看得出制作组是要在第二关展现他们的游戏设计水准，但在如此短的培养时间里塞这么异常的难度阶梯实在是让人感觉是不是故意折磨玩家，再加上黑屏卡死这种恶性bug，体验极差，建议尽快修复。

说真的，玩过《化妆镜~黄金之梦》和《little goody two shoes》（后简称lgts）后，我就觉着这个制作组是怎么用如此豪华的音乐美术制作出游戏性相对较低的观赏艺术品的。 化妆镜可以算是制作组想要通过在同类型游戏中做出顶级的美术来讲述好游戏故事和提高玩家游戏体验的一个初步尝试，但怪就怪在化妆镜中，制作组放弃了传统RPG恐怖解密转而进行大量的人物叙事，导致整体游戏解密部分几乎可以忽略，而且人物对话有点莫名其妙或者谜语人了。 lgts中我个人觉得在美术方面有明显的进步，但整体游戏的节奏就很奇怪，既要花时间约会刷好感来达成其他结局，又要挣钱来保证主角健康，到特定节点还要去推主线，听着可能不觉得繁琐，但要是我告诉你挣钱的小游戏无法跳过，推不同的角色结局还要读老前面的档还要再过主线剧情以及追逐部分，游戏性这块是真不怎么样的。 《地狱公主》首发就拿下了，因为没怎么玩过类吸血鬼幸存者这类游戏，就想着这应该是类肉鸽卡牌构筑游戏吧，但实际体验下来，目前没有可以发生质变的配合，整个游戏过程就是不断升级拉角色和武器数值，角色和部分武器的性能都偏低（羽毛笔那点攻击范围是认真的?），一点爽感都没有，而且两层地狱中的出怪时间都是固定的，局内除了占点提数值就是升级刷牌了（不知道是类吸血鬼幸存者的设定，但游戏性绝对没有这么低）。 优点还是有的：还是美术音乐顶尖嘛，有跟lgts一样有全英语配音，游戏题材则是改编西方的但丁神话，这次还请来了mili制作主题曲《Not My Paradiso》，有大量百合成分（仅对话） 目前游戏还是处于抢先体验版本，仅有两层关卡，不推荐大家多花时间游玩，但可以提前趁低价入手观望下更新内容（EA版警告），如果制作组能兑现承诺的话，这款游戏没准是一个新星，唔，但愿制作组不要过于沉浸在百合和美术中了，多少玩过游戏或者看看玩家反馈也好。 对了对了，想起来了，nmd，lgts的中文呢？都几年了还没出？！真该问候制作组你们了！

As it is now, I can't recommend it, even though I would love to. The story is fun, the graphics are neat, the little videos for the magic attacks are cool, the music is fantastic, the weapon power up system is well thought out. But then there is the difficulty... I have played many Bullet Heaven RogueLites, but I didn't struggle with any of them as hard as I do with this game. The second stage "Lust" is just insulting. Even if you level up your movement speed to the Max in Meta progression, enemies in "Lust" very quickly become faster than you, projectiles from the first group of Elites are approximately twice as fast as you - and they are homing, which means you can't outmaneuver them. The only way to get through this part reliably is with one specific magic attack - Horace's, which in turn also forces you to use her main weapon, which starts slow and weak, which in turn results in you leveling slower in the beginning of the stage. I have no problem beating the first stage - I did so multiple times, but stage two is not fun to play. Also, the currency for advancing Meta progression is handed out incredibly stingy. If you don't get lucky during the stage to get offered a multiplier at a Level Up, you will grind a long, long time to get any meaningful progress done... In short: This game needs a re-balance before it can be recommended. (Edited for easier readability).

There are several serious issues that prompted me to leave a negative review 1. The issue of weapon balance is not that some weapons are too strong, but rather that some weapons are simply too weak 2. After a monster is killed, the experience points will only drop after the monster's death animation is played. However, in such games, players must keep moving, so they often cannot obtain the experience points in a timely manner 3. The succubi in the second level are too powerful, and there are no countermeasures, *which is almost the most serious problem*. The tracking bullets launched are too fast in both frequency and trajectory speed, and it is impossible to evade them with the character's movement speed. Moreover, the frequency of teleportation is too high, and the teleportation locations are too far away from the character. Players can only rely on luck to kill these succubi, which forces me to use the tank to survive the first circle smoothly, making it impossible to play with other weapons.

Tough game to score. On the one hand, it does have its strengths: Cool anime-quality opening and ultimate spell attack animations, some cool music with a good beat to it, and a vivid, colorful visual style. On the other hand, it has gameplay that feels boring at best, painful at worst, and awkward in between. You try things out, conclude that most options are garbage, and then stick with the things that work - mainly melee sweep attacks for fast, reliable group damage and knockback, quantity upgrades to multiply your damage output, crit chance and crit damage, and just higher base damage if you can get them. This lets you wade through hordes of enemies without getting hit too much, meaning you get loads of experience orbs, lots of level-ups, and more power to throw at the boss once you get there. The runs are quite short - 12 minutes before the final gimmicky pattern-dodging type boss of each level - so you really can't afford to run around tossing Virgil's absolute garbage spheres once every five seconds, or Horace's crappy boomerang spear that just flies off, spins on the spot in the middle of nowhere, and eventually flies back to you for a second weak, weak hit on the enemy who's been whaling on you for seven seconds. Homer's homing dove missiles are tolerable. Dante's own starting weapon, the melee quill slash, is certainly the best. Unfortunately, this means unlocking the poets' powers feels [i]completely[/i] pointless - yes, they unlock some [i]other[/i] weapons that don't all suck, but overall the amount of useless crap in your random weapon selections will remain uncomfortably high. At no point did I find myself going "WOW! Poison and fire work SO WELL, how meaningful that I got those upgrades!" Nope. A few tiny ticks of inconsequentially minimal damage? You can practically hear the enemies yawning. Similarly, anything that increases knockback? Not going to help when forty enemies are sprinting toward you from all sides, conspicuously undefeated. Weirdly, the weapon that carried me through the second circle was the wind blower. It's slow to charge up, it takes a while to start firing, and weirdly it is seemingly unaffected by the duration stat, DESPITE clearly being an attack that takes place over a period of time (while it is blowing). See, if you mess around with upgrade cards, have a little luck, and put some "increase quantity of adjacent weapons" cards on the things beside it, you can end up with an awful lot of wind blower mouths. You can then spin your aiming focus while optionally shouting "Wheee!" and pretty much obliterate any and all enemies around you. The knockback is too weak to do much, but that works in your favor since the enemy remains in range for the next wind mouth to hit them. And the next. And the next. The damage is pretty decent on them, too, so a rapid spin plus a lot of blowers equals "ouch" for the foe. Even took out the boss pretty handily. Here's another gripe: The bosses cheat. Yes, you could argue that it is normal for boss enemies to sometimes turn invincible for a segment or two where you have to focus on evading their attacks because attacking is no longer an option. I would argue that is a nonsense mechanic made up by people who suck at coming up with fun boss designs. And hey, agree to disagree. Fine. But when you've reduced the boss to zero health, and the boss tosses an EXTENSIVE final attack sequence at you before admitting that okay, yeah, you won the fight? That is what I would call cheating. That is the kid in the playground pulling out his invisible everything-proof shield that covers his whole body while you're all trying to play some kind of semi-plausible fantasy combat thing you made up on the spot. It doesn't add anything, for me; nothing but irritation. Your mileage may vary. Maybe some people love forced bullet hell sequences after a roguelite boss fight? Who can say. And yeah. You could grind the same two levels until you have some more upgrades unlocked. I managed with maybe half of them, but I couldn't tell you how I survived half the crap the second map throws at you. I imagine playing it again, and I go "nope, don't wanna do that". Probably more boss dialogue waiting, but this game has just kind of lost me at this point; it's... not fun to play. As I've said, at best it's just boring. Either you go optimal, min-maxing, same thing over and over again, or you get used to the death screen. And don't forget to get carpal tunnel from the amount of dodge-dashing you'll have to do. Again, in the second map, I was just spamming dash-dodges and hoping for the best, while madly spinning my soon-to-be-nerfed wind blower array. The issue isn't that some things work well, here. The issue is that so many things do not. If the developers of this game really want to create an enjoyable experience, they need to sit down and look at each and every attack ability they have, and ask themselves, "Would I use this? How well would it go? How can we make this viable, and not just filler trash that everyone who's used it will immediately reroll or banish?" For now, it's not recommended. A lot of the things in it are cool, but the gameplay is not. Sad to see.

把成就应该打完了，除了朝圣者之旅一，全球完成率为0%，应该暂时无法获得。 其中但丁和荷马全改造卡需要分别去抓挂毒牌/挂燃烧牌，然后卡池里会出现给毒和燃烧拐的牌，拿齐了就有了。 我是冲着美术和mili的主题曲来的，人物确实很好看，卡图我也很喜欢，momo唱歌也很好听。除了剧情和动画没那么多以外都挺满意的，希望可以多做一点。 我还希望在大厅里加个卡牌图鉴之类的东西，也方便大伙做成就（我在但丁和荷马全改造卡成就上花了很多时间才知道缺了什么） （哦对了，我觉得护符没必要做成3D的。） 再来谈谈游戏性方面，第二关第一波。火圈里火史莱姆和尾迹碰到就硬直，魅魔的飞弹速度快数量多，本体打完就跑，能击中的时间窗口甚至可能没有玩家武器的冷却时间长，在前期局外成长不高的情况下基本不能及时清理掉，同时第二关和第一关给的悲鸣还相差无几，导致玩家在第二关开头性价比最高的事是去回第一关去刷悲鸣。 （而且不管第一关还是第二关给的悲鸣数量我认为都过低了）考虑到目前只有两关，多增加些玩家在第一关的时间也没什么问题，但游玩流程上太反直觉了，很影响游玩体验。 还有，玩家成型后（尤其是先版本最强力的武器卡及时行乐的攻击动画过于缭乱——而且它是金色的哎，我玩了一天眼睛都要瞎了）的弹幕可能会直接覆盖整个屏幕，而玩家还需要在这种情况下去躲BOSS的机制，虽然依旧能靠血量去通过boss——虽然我并没有玩过其他同类游戏，但我认为这在游戏设计上毫无疑问是错误的（在转阶段和最终阶段时不能去给boss造成伤害提前结束战斗，那么跑机制就是必要的）。希望增加类似调整弹幕透明度一类的功能。 最后，第二关的关底boss有很大的概率在最终阶段时第一波岩浆的机制放不出来。 总的来说，我还是愿意给个好评的，有很多地方值得改进，不过最重要的还是先把内容做出来，多做一点——我指的是剧情，和人物的互动，以及可能的动画之类，毕竟这才是你们的主要卖点，不是吗？
